reports.title: Pre-Flight for Vibe Coders: An App Store Rejection Scanner and 5 Sibling Ideas
reports.summary: Apple rejected 2.09M of 9.1M submissions in 2025, but pre-submission checkers are already crowded at $2.99–$199. The opening is a scanner built for vibe coders that checks the web wrapper, the backend and AI consent together. Five sibling ideas are ranked alongside it.

reports.title: 15 Low-Barrier Creative Aftermarket Opportunities for Optimus
reports.summary: Optimus is being built but not sold. These are 15 fun, low-capital aftermarket ideas (costumes, shells, decals, booths, wranglers), split into ones you can start now on robots you can rent today and ones that wait for robots in homes.
reports.mascot_says: Every robot deserves an ugly holiday sweater.

reports.title: 10 Micro-SaaS & Low-Maintenance Niche Opportunities
reports.summary: Ten single-purpose services built on the CharacterGuard pattern (free check, one-time kit, cheap watch), ranked on margin, maintenance, speed, and cited demand. SMS registration readiness and inbox-authentication fixes lead.
reports.mascot_says: Best niches had a hard rule behind them and a free check that can say ‘stop.’
